name: Three Bean Salad
description: Easy recipe to expand - black turtle beans and chickpeas also work well here.

ingredients.name: Salad Oil
ingredients.originalText: 1/3 cup Salad Oil (olive oil, canola, or sunflower)

instructions.text: Set out a large salad bowl, whisk, colander, knife, and cutting board. Measure the dressing ingredients before opening the beans.

Whisk 1/3 cup salad oil, 1/2 cup cider vinegar, 1 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon pepper, 1/4 cup sugar, and 1/2 teaspoon celery seed in the salad bowl until the sugar is mostly dissolved and the dressing is blended.

Open one can cut green beans, one can cut waxed beans, and one can red kidney beans. Empty them into the colander, rinse under cold water, and leave to drain well. Can sizes are not specified by the source.

Wash 1 carrot and 1 bell pepper. Peel the carrot and 1 small onion, thinly slice the carrot, chop the onion, and remove the pepper stem and seeds before chopping the pepper into small bite-size pieces.
Add the prepared vegetables and drained beans to the dressing. Fold gently with a large spoon until coated, taking care not to mash the kidney beans.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving, stirring occasionally to redistribute the dressing. Keep the salad chilled at 40°F (4°C) or colder. Divide into 8 servings.

source.author: Joel Maxuel
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put dressing ingredients in a large salad bowl an whisk until blended.
2. Empty cans of beans into a colander and rinse under cold water.
3. Chop remaining vegetables and add to dressing.  Add beans and gently stir.
4. Refrigerate for at least an hour before serving, stirring occasionally.
